## FAQ


### What are the top 10 stocks in Warren Buffett's portfolio?


Berkshire Hathaway's latest 13F (Q3 2026) lists Apple, American Express, Alphabet, Coca-Cola, Bank of America, Chevron, Occidental Petroleum, Moody's, Chubb and Kraft Heinz as its 10 largest holdings. Greg Abel has run Berkshire as CEO since 1 January 2026, and Warren Buffett is its chairman.


### When does Berkshire file its next 13F?


The Q4 2026 filing is due by Tuesday 16 February 2027. This page is refreshed after each filing.
